4432.title: Plugin reload cancels new-instance startup question
4432.rootCauseOneLine: New factory runs before old disposal; plugin-wide interruption cancels the new generation question.
4432.proposedFix: Scope disposal interruption to the outgoing instance generation.
4432.caveats: Two real-service/database runs with a settled initial form. Same-thread admission guard prevents two simultaneous pending forms; browser rendering untested.
